entries.title: Age of Darkness: Final Stand
entries.definitive_edition: Age of Darkness: Final Stand 1.0 on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Age of Darkness: Final Stand left Early Access on January 15, 2025, with the 1.0 Steam release adding co-operative multiplayer. It has Windows system requirements, and no console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC is therefore the complete route and the best archive capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam 1.0 release. Use campaign, survival, and co-op modes as separate capture notes if documenting feature coverage.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with campaign, survival, and online co-op in the 1.0 route.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and best archive route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; 1.0 added co-operative multiplayer to the main Steam release.
